name: Can tenants in ADUs use the primary home's amenities?

mainEntity.name: Can tenants in ADUs use the primary home's amenities?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADUs must have independent access and living facilities, but shared driveways, yards, or laundry may be permitted depending on local regulations and agreements.
